description: FastAPI route definitions for CRUD operations on notes, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting notes.

methods.name: list_notes
methods.description: Returns all notes ordered by updated_at descending.

methods.name: get_note
methods.description: Fetch a single note by its id.

methods.name: create_note
methods.description: Create a new note, setting created_at and updated_at timestamps.

methods.name: update_note
methods.description: Update an existing note and its updated_at timestamp.
